filters.semantic_query: A named chemical, drug, pesticide, cosmetic ingredient, or other molecule was applied to skin, and experimental skin penetration was quantified as permeability coefficient Kp, steady-state flux, lag time, absorbed dose, receptor-fluid recovery, skin-layer retention, tape-strip concentration, or formulation-dependent permeation using diffusion cells or in vivo dermal exposure.

A named chemical, metal, drug, pesticide, cosmetic ingredient, or other test substance was applied to skin and experimentally measured percutaneous absorption, transdermal flux, permeability, lag time, receptor-fluid recovery, or retention in stratum corneum, epidermis, or dermis.

The experimentally measured skin permeability coefficient Kp, steady-state transdermal flux, or lag time of a named test compound was reported from diffusion-cell or in vivo dermal penetration experiments.
